adapter.description: The adapter that connects the chat to your backend.

features.description: Runtime feature flags for the chat controller (e.g. outbound typing signals).

onData.description: Callback fired when a data part is received.

onError.description: Callback fired when an error occurs.

onFinish.description: Callback fired when the assistant finishes a response, including when it is aborted, disconnected, or fails.

onToolCall.description: Callback fired when the assistant calls a tool.

partRenderers.description: Custom renderers for message parts, by part type.

storeClass.description: The store class to use for this provider.

streamFlushInterval.description: Flush interval in milliseconds for batching rapid streaming deltas before applying them to the store.
